opportunities.title: ZachXBT Paid $350K Out of His Own Pocket to Catch Lazarus' Launderers — Because No One Else Would
opportunities.why_now: A solo researcher self-funded an undercover op into alleged Chinese laundering networks tied to the Bybit hack, exposing how under-resourced official enforcement still is.
opportunities.angle: Security deep-dive on vigilante OSINT economics vs. state capacity; include methodology and what it reveals about Lazarus laundering rails

opportunities.title: NEAR Intents Got Its $3.8M Back With an Ultimatum. Here's Why That Keeps Working
opportunities.why_now: Full recovery of a $3.8M exploit via direct negotiation is the latest in a pattern of protocols threatening exploiters into returning funds instead of relying on law enforcement.
opportunities.angle: Explainer/pattern piece on the 'return it or we doxx you' playbook — incentives, precedent cases, and when it fails

opportunities.title: Treasury Just Killed the Mixer Rule the Same Week DOJ Doubled Down on Roman Storm
opportunities.why_now: FinCEN withdrew its unhosted-wallet/mixer surveillance proposal citing chilling effects, while DOJ simultaneously presses its case against Tornado Cash's founder — a direct policy contradiction.
opportunities.angle: Analysis piece on regulatory incoherence: what actually changed for mixer users and developers, and what Storm's case still threatens

opportunities.title: The SEC Just Approved 3x Leveraged Bitcoin Funds. Bitcoin Is Down 32% From Its High.
opportunities.why_now: Regulators cleared 3x leveraged BTC/ETH products for trading at the exact moment BTC is getting rejected at $87K and sitting a third below its ATH — a timing irony security-minded readers will appreciate.
opportunities.angle: Risk-first breakdown of leverage decay math using the current price action as the live example; 'already priced' framing on who eats the losses

opportunities.title: A Crypto 'Godfather' Hired Off-Duty Sheriff's Deputies to Run a $37M Ad Fraud. He Got Six Years.
opportunities.why_now: Fresh sentencing in a scheme that used law-enforcement cover to run a $37M Meta ad fraud operation is a stark case study in how crypto fraud launders legitimacy, not just money.
opportunities.angle: Crime-and-punishment writeup focused on the operational playbook (corrupting local law enforcement) as a security lesson, not just a headline
